title: P0 adoption and security journey closure
rawUserRequest: 查收，执行计划。我授权给你，并写入Contract。

declaredIntent.requestedOutcome: Complete the trilingual P0 adoption and security journey after WI-4, with explicit human boundaries and same-language routes.

outOfScope: Runtime behavior, release metadata, and publication.
P1 mechanism details beyond a P0 trust-boundary overview.
WI-6 comprehension interviews and final capability claims.

sources.reason: Approved WI-5 scope and P0 writing contract.
Canonical topic ownership and activation state.

riskAssessment.reason: P0 adoption and security guidance can change a reader's authority and safety decisions; parity and human-boundary tests are required.

reasons: P0 adoption and security guidance is safety-relevant and must use strict evidence gates.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly authorized sequential execution of all remaining Work Items and requested that authorization be recorded in the Contract.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Reconcile installation, calibration, and first Work Item routes with all three localized homes without silent fallback.
Add complete English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese P0 security/trust-boundary overview pages with explicit external responsibility.
Activate first-calibration, first-work-item, and security-boundaries only when all locale siblings and route tests pass.
Add structural tests for adoption route parity, security boundary semantics, registry ownership, and no unsafe authority claims.
guidelines: Use the P0 writing contract and progressive disclosure for every adoption and security page.
Keep installation, calibration, first Work Item, and security semantics equivalent across locales; no silent English fallback.
State which controls remain external and never imply that documentation grants runtime or provider authority.
Do not modify runtime behavior, release metadata, or P1 mechanism ownership.

intent.problem: After WI-4, a reader can interpret decisions and recovery but still cannot complete the adoption journey or understand the security boundary in all three languages. The remaining gap can cause unsafe assumptions about calibration, first use, or what AI Cockpit controls.
constraints: Complete only WI-5 adoption and security P0 topics; WI-6 owns human comprehension validation.
Preserve existing installation behavior and external responsibility boundaries.
Do not claim full translation or security coverage for P1 mechanisms.
intent.rationale: A project understanding journey is incomplete if a reader reaches the first action without a same-language adoption path or mistakes governance evidence for a security sandbox. Closing these routes makes the documented North Star actionable without expanding product claims.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A non-technical reader follows installation, calibration, and first Work Item links from each localized home.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The reader reaches a same-language first-use route without fallback or ambiguous authority.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run route, locale parity, and registry tests and inspect each home-to-first-use path.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A reader encounters an untrusted input or security concern and distinguishes Cockpit governance from external security controls.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The reader stops unsafe assumptions and follows the named external control owner.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run security-boundary semantic tests and inspect all three localized pages for external-responsibility invariants.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
